families.positive: Generate real random nonce bytes; parse actual returned DER with existing parseDer/children/expectTag/oid/uintHex, and independently compare fixed TLV byte fragments.
checks: One SEQUENCE with exactly version,imprint,nonce,certReq elements. VersionINTEGER content01.
SHA256 OID2.16.840.1.101.3.4.2.1 encoded0609608648016503040201 plus DER NULL0500; imprint OCTETSTRING is exact32raw digest bytes.
nonceHex is16lowercasehex with high magnitude bit set. Actual nonce INTEGER uses positive minimal9byte encoding00||8noncebytes and uintHex equals nonceHex.
Final certReq BOOLEAN TLV exactly0101ff; no reqPolicy element.
families.limit: One or several observed nonces do not prove entropy, unpredictability or collision freedom; do not assert random inequality or mock randomBytes.

checks: Exactly one policy OID inserted between imprint and nonce; remaining required fields/nonce relation/certReq preserved.
Assert literal OID bytes06042a030401 or decoded1.2.3.4.1, with independent fixed-byte comparison.
families.limit: Do not invent a direct-build malformedreqPolicy refusal; the public builder accepts astring and the separate config schema is not this cohort.

checks: Reject empty/nonhex/uppercase/63/65character digests with the actual fixed error before returning bytes.
families.limit: Typed string inputs only; no any/casts/runtime monkeypatch objects.

families.positive: Real HTTP server bound to exact127.0.0.1 and ephemeral port returns finite synthetic binary bytes under200/application-timestamp-reply.
checks: Exactly one received POST; exact path+query, Hostconfigured literal/port, Content-Typeapplication/timestamp-query, Acceptapplication/timestamp-reply, Content-Length and exact real request DER body.
Returned Buffer exactly matches synthetic public response bytes. Observe all fixture-owned request/response/socket terminals.
families.limit: Raw bytes deliberately have no claimed CMS/TSA/AttestedTime meaning. No requestTimestamp grant is called or invented.

families.positive: Use200 with Application/Timestamp-Reply ; charset=binary and the same finite body.
checks: Case-folding/parameter stripping still accepts exact reply bytes.
families.limit: This normalizes a Content-Type media type; it does not relax signature or content verification.

checks: URL with synthetic username/password rejects the fixed configured-URL credential error; no fixture request counter increments.
Never use a real credential or publish userinfo-bearing URLs/error operands; report only refusal/count booleans.
families.limit: Unchanged scopedegress also rejects credential destinations; this test does not establish that the first credential guard is the only barrier.

checks: Finite201/500 status rows reject exactHTTPstatus messages. A wrongstatus+wrongMIMErow may record status-before-type precedence; do not count rows as extra test bodies.
families.limit: All fixture responses end naturally; no real remote service availability claim.

checks: A302Location targeting another path on the same owned literalIPserver rejects redirect(HTTP302)refused.
One source-route request and zero target-route requests; no external Location URL.
families.limit: No universal redirect/destination policy proof; this is the concrete real client response path.

checks: Same finite body with200/text-plain rejects exact content-type refusal. First meaningful control assertion is promise rejection, then independent counts/lifecycle facts.
families.limit: Transport type admission only; never invoke token verifier to explain this refusal.

families.positive: Exactly65536public bytes under200/correctMIME are returned intact.
checks: 65537bytes reject replyexceeds65536bytes. Keep response finite, accurate Content-Length and endpoint-body byte record.
Oversize may cause expected peer abort/response-close before finish; retain those actual terminal facts and separate unexpected errors.
families.limit: A64KiBcap is transport size behavior, not total process memory/streaming/DER security proof.

families.positive: Previously qualified finite positive uses the same public default path.
checks: A separately isolated fixture accepts the request but deliberately never sends response headers/body; real defaultAbortSignal.timeout(10000) must reject.
Keep client10000ms and Vitest30000ms defaults; no fakeclock/sleep race/shortened timeoutMs/deadline extension. Capture actual abort category/duration and peer closure, not a predicted elapsed result.
families.limit: The timer is created after checkedAddress; exactIPskipsDNS. This does not prove a10second bound for DNS resolution, complete fallback or all outer operations. Actual timeout/finally closure must be observed before credit.
